  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail

          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          title: Timestamp

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type

        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      properties:
        message:

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:

          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Any non-digit characters are

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
